info.title: Availity Universal API
info.description: Availity provides REST APIs for HIPAA healthcare transactions, including payer lookup, eligibility and benefits, claim status, dental claims, and patient cost estimate workflows.

post.description: Creates a claim status inquiry in Availity.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

claimStatus.description: Claim status inquiry request body. For demo POST scenarios, Availity documents that an empty JSON body may be used.

claimAmount.description: Claim amount submitted in the inquiry.

claimCount.description: Number of matching claim status records.

controlNumber.description: Control number returned for the inquiry.

customerId.description: Availity customer identifier for the claim status inquiry.

updatedDate.description: Claim status inquiry last update timestamp.

userId.description: Availity user identifier associated with the inquiry.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

get.description: Retrieves payers and supported transactions from Availity.

parameters.description: Availity-specific payer identifier to narrow the payer list.

schema.description: Availity-specific payer identifier to narrow the payer list.

parameters.name: transactionTypes
parameters.description: EDI/HIPAA transaction type code, such as 270, 276, 837P, 837I, or 837D.

schema.description: EDI/HIPAA transaction type code, such as 270, 276, 837P, 837I, or 837D.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.
